subject: a tall stack of three thick, fluffy buttermilk pancakes crowned with a generous dollop of softly whipped cream and fresh strawberries, with glossy strawberry sauce spooned over the top and running down one side

geometry.silhouette: 3단 두툼 스택(약 2.5cm/장), 돔 윗면, 부푼 둥근 가장자리, 손으로 놓은 오프셋, 높이≈폭의 60%, 프레임 폭 65% 점유. 토핑은 전부 윗면에 얹힘(반죽에 박지 않음).
geometry.body: Three thick, tender pancakes stacked with a small, casual offset, as if placed by hand rather than aligned by a machine — the middle one shifted a little to the right, the top one a little back. Each pancake is a plump, pillowy round about 2.5 cm thick with a gently domed top and a soft rounded edge that bulges slightly outward where the batter rose in the pan; the stack is about 60% as tall as it is wide and occupies roughly 65% of the frame width, leaving generous empty background around it. The top face of each pancake is griddle-browned in a soft, blotchy, uneven gradient — warm caramel brown (#B9793F) at the centre where it sat longest on the hot pan, fading through toasty golden (#CF9455) into light golden (#D9A76B) toward the rim, with a few slightly darker freckles and one paler patch where a bubble lifted the batter, the way real pancakes never brown evenly. The side wall of every pancake is the pale cream of the risen crumb (#F1DDB0): a soft, spongy band with a fine open crumb texture, tiny irregular air pockets catching the light, meeting the browned top in a soft blurred edge rather than a hard line. A few tiny pinprick pores sit near the rim of the top pancake, barely visible. Where the pancakes touch, the top one presses very slightly into the one below, so the edges kiss softly instead of floating. The whole stack looks warm, tender and freshly flipped — the honest irregularity of a handmade bake.

toppings.label: WHIPPED CREAM
toppings.text: One generous dollop of lightly whipped cream (#FFF8EC), about the size of a large spoonful, sitting slightly off-centre toward the front-left of the top pancake. It has been dropped from a spoon, not piped: soft, rounded peaks with gentle folds and one curl on top, a matte velvety surface with a faint ivory warmth, slumping a little under the weight of the fruit and just beginning to soften where the warm pancake and the sauce touch it, so its lower edge relaxes outward into a soft skirt with a slightly translucent rim.

toppings.label: STRAWBERRIES
toppings.text: About five fresh, ripe strawberries in glossy red (#D8322E), each with tiny pale yellow seeds set in shallow dimples across the skin and a natural moist sheen, no two the same size or shape: two whole berries with their green leafy calyx (#4F7A3A) still attached, one large and one smaller, leaning against the cream at different angles with their tips pointing different ways; and three halves cut lengthwise, showing the pale pink-white heart fading into red flesh with the faint radiating grain of a real cut strawberry — the largest half laid flat on the cream cut-face up, one half tilted against the side of the dollop, and one small half sitting on the bare browned pancake near the rim with a tiny bead of juice pooling under it. A couple of seeds and a smear of red juice have been left behind on the cream where a berry was moved.

toppings.label: SAUCE
toppings.text: A spoonful of glossy, translucent strawberry sauce (#B8202A) with a few tiny soft fruit pieces in it, spooned loosely over the fruit and cream so it pools briefly in the hollows, coats the top of one berry, and then runs down the front side of the stack in three uneven drips of different lengths and widths — one thick drip reaching the middle pancake and rounding into a soft bead at its tip, one thinner one stopping short at the top pancake’s edge, and one just beginning. The sauce is thick and slow like a warm compote, catching a bright soft highlight along each drip and turning the crumb it touches a darker, glossy soaked red-brown.

toppings.label: FINISHING
toppings.text: A barely-there haze of powdered sugar dusted over the berries and the pancake rim, settling in the seed dimples and the folds of the cream and dissolving into faint translucent specks where it touches the sauce. One small sprig of fresh mint with two crisp leaves (#3E7A45) tucked into the cream beside the strawberries. The toppings gather toward the front-left so the browned pancake surface stays visible on the opposite side, and the composition reads as one deliberate, appetizing arrangement — realistic portion size, no duplicate identical elements.

materials_lighting: Premium food-icon look: slightly simplified, clean forms with believable, appetizing materials — matte tender pancake crumb with a faint velvety sheen only where it browned, soft-matte cream, naturally glossy strawberry skin with soft specular highlights, translucent glossy sauce, waxy mint leaves. Soft studio softbox key light from the upper left with gentle warm ambient fill, a subtle rim of light along the top edges of the stack, and a faint, soft contact shadow directly beneath the stack only. Appetizing food-photography color grading: warm, fresh, clean whites, saturated but natural colours, no colour cast on the background. Shot as if with an 85 mm lens at a comfortable distance, everything in crisp focus.
